import Mathlib
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Axler_exercise_5_20 {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V] {S T : End F V}
  (h1 : card (T.Eigenvalues) = finrank F V)
  (h2 : ∀ v : V, (∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace S c) ↔ (∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace T c)) :
  S * T = T * S := by
  classical
  let v : T.Eigenvalues → V := fun μ =>
    Classical.choose
      (show T.HasEigenvalue (μ : F) from μ.property).exists_hasEigenvector
  
  have hv (μ : T.Eigenvalues) : T.HasEigenvector (μ : F) (v μ) := by
    exact Classical.choose_spec
      (show T.HasEigenvalue (μ : F) from μ.property).exists_hasEigenvector
  
  have hli : LinearIndependent F v := by
    apply T.eigenvectors_linearIndependent
    intro μ
    exact hv μ
  
  by_cases hn : Nonempty T.Eigenvalues
  · let b : Basis T.Eigenvalues F V :=
      basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli h1
  
    have hb (μ : T.Eigenvalues) : b μ = v μ := by
      change (basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli h1) μ = v μ
      rw [coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank]
  
    apply b.ext
    intro μ
  
    have hμT : T (v μ) = (μ : F) • v μ :=
      (hv μ).apply_eq_smul
  
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (h2 (v μ)).mpr ⟨(μ : F), (hv μ).left⟩
  
    have hμS : S (v μ) = c • v μ :=
      mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hc
  
    change S (T (b μ)) = T (S (b μ))
    rw [hb, hμT, map_smul, hμS, map_smul]
    simp only [hμT, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm]
  
  · have hzero : finrank F V = 0 := by
      rw [← h1, Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff]
      exact not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
  
    have hV : Subsingleton V := Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hzero
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

import Mathlib
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Axler_exercise_5_20 {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V] {S T : End F V}
  (h1 : card (T.Eigenvalues) = finrank F V)
  (h2 : ∀ v : V, (∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace S c) ↔ (∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace T c)) :
  S * T = T * S := by
  classical
  have h_exists :
      ∀ l : T.Eigenvalues, ∃ v : V, T.HasEigenvector (l : F) v := by
    intro l
    exact Module.End.HasEigenvalue.exists_hasEigenvector
      (f := T) (μ := (l : F)) l.property
  choose eigenvec h_eigenvec using h_exists
  have h_linearIndependent :
      LinearIndependent F (fun l : T.Eigenvalues ↦ eigenvec l) :=
    T.eigenvectors_linearIndependent'
      (fun l : T.Eigenvalues ↦ (l : F))
      Subtype.coe_injective
      (fun l ↦ eigenvec l)
      (fun l ↦ h_eigenvec l)
  have h_span :
      Submodule.span F (Set.range (fun l : T.Eigenvalues ↦ eigenvec l)) = ⊤ := by
    have h_card : Fintype.card T.Eigenvalues = finrank F V := by
      simpa using h1
    exact LinearIndependent.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank'
      h_linearIndependent h_card
  have h_comm_on_basis :
      ∀ l : T.Eigenvalues,
        ((S * T) - (T * S)) (eigenvec l) = 0 := by
    intro l
    have h_T_apply :
        T (eigenvec l) = (l : F) • eigenvec l :=
      Module.End.HasEigenvector.apply_eq_smul (h_eigenvec l)
    have h_mem_T :
        eigenvec l ∈ eigenspace T (l : F) :=
      (Module.End.hasEigenvector_iff.mp (h_eigenvec l)).1
    obtain ⟨μ, h_mem_S⟩ :=
      (h2 (eigenvec l)).mpr ⟨(l : F), h_mem_T⟩
    have h_S_apply :
        S (eigenvec l) = μ • eigenvec l :=
      mem_eigenspace_iff.mp h_mem_S
    have h_ST :
        (S * T) (eigenvec l) = ((l : F) * μ) • eigenvec l := by
      simp [Module.End.mul_apply, h_T_apply, h_S_apply, smul_smul]
    have h_TS :
        (T * S) (eigenvec l) = (μ * (l : F)) • eigenvec l := by
      simp [Module.End.mul_apply, h_T_apply, h_S_apply, smul_smul]
    simp [LinearMap.sub_apply, h_ST, h_TS, mul_comm]
  have h_span_le :
      Submodule.span F (Set.range (fun l : T.Eigenvalues ↦ eigenvec l)) ≤
        LinearMap.ker ((S * T) - (T * S)) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro x ⟨l, rfl⟩
    simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using h_comm_on_basis l
  have h_top_le :
      (⊤ : Submodule F V) ≤ LinearMap.ker ((S * T) - (T * S)) := by
    simpa [h_span] using h_span_le
  have h_zero : (S * T) - (T * S) = 0 := by
    ext v
    have hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker ((S * T) - (T * S)) :=
      h_top_le (by simp)
    simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using hv
  simpa using sub_eq_zero.mp h_zero
